messages.content:
Create CTL2 for an ExtHashJoin component. Port 0 is the master PurchaseOrder input, port 1 is the slave Vendor input, and the graph uses a left outer join on PurchaseOrder.vendor_id = Vendor.vendor_id. There is at most one Vendor row per vendor_id.

Port 0 metadata:
<Metadata id="PurchaseOrderIn"><Record name="PurchaseOrder" type="delimited"><Field name="po_id" type="string"/><Field name="vendor_id" type="string"/><Field name="order_date" type="date"/><Field name="currency" type="string"/><Field name="ordered_amount" type="decimal"/><Field name="delivery_days_promised" type="integer"/><Field name="compliance_required" type="boolean"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 1 metadata:
<Metadata id="VendorIn"><Record name="Vendor" type="delimited"><Field name="vendor_id" type="string"/><Field name="vendor_name" type="string"/><Field name="risk_tier" type="string"/><Field name="payment_terms_days" type="integer"/><Field name="preferred_currency" type="string"/><Field name="compliance_expiry" type="date"/></Record></Metadata>
Output metadata:
<Metadata id="PurchaseOrderReviewOut"><Record name="PurchaseOrderReview" type="delimited"><Field name="po_id" type="string"/><Field name="vendor_name" type="string"/><Field name="payment_due_date" type="date"/><Field name="delivery_due_date" type="date"/><Field name="review_status" type="string"/><Field name="review_reason" type="string"/><Field name="currency_variance" type="decimal"/></Record></Metadata>

Business logic:
- A missing slave Vendor row produces vendor_name UNKNOWN, payment_due_date and delivery_due_date equal to order_date, review_status HOLD, review_reason VENDOR_NOT_FOUND, and currency_variance zero.
- Otherwise payment_due_date is order_date plus payment_terms_days and delivery_due_date is order_date plus delivery_days_promised.
- review_status is HOLD when compliance_required is true and compliance_expiry is null or before order_date; REVIEW when risk_tier is HIGH or ordered_amount exceeds 100000; APPROVED otherwise. Review reason precedence is COMPLIANCE_EXPIRED, HIGH_RISK_VENDOR, HIGH_VALUE_ORDER, then null.
- currency_variance is zero when currency equals preferred_currency, otherwise ordered_amount multiplied by 0.03 and rounded to two decimals. Equality is case-sensitive.

Write a transformation for an ExtHashJoin. Port 0 is the master LoginAttempt input and port 1 is the slave IdentityProfile input. The graph uses a left outer join on LoginAttempt.user_id = IdentityProfile.user_id; one profile exists at most once per user.

Port 0 metadata:
<Metadata id="LoginAttemptIn"><Record name="LoginAttempt" type="delimited"><Field name="attempt_id" type="string"/><Field name="user_id" type="string"/><Field name="attempt_time" type="date"/><Field name="ip_country" type="string"/><Field name="device_fingerprint" type="string"/><Field name="failed_attempts_24h" type="integer"/><Field name="password_reset_recent" type="boolean"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 1 metadata:
<Metadata id="IdentityProfileIn"><Record name="IdentityProfile" type="delimited"><Field name="user_id" type="string"/><Field name="home_country" type="string"/><Field name="kyc_status" type="string"/><Field name="kyc_expiry" type="date"/><Field name="trusted_device_fingerprints" type="string" containerType="list"/><Field name="account_created" type="date"/></Record></Metadata>
Output metadata:
<Metadata id="LoginRiskOut"><Record name="LoginRisk" type="delimited"><Field name="attempt_id" type="string"/><Field name="user_id" type="string"/><Field name="risk_score" type="integer"/><Field name="access_decision" type="string"/><Field name="primary_reason" type="string"/><Field name="profile_status" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>

Business logic:
- A missing profile yields score 100, DENY, primary_reason PROFILE_NOT_FOUND, and profile_status MISSING.
- For a matched profile, score starts at zero; add 35 if ip_country differs from home_country, 30 if device_fingerprint is absent from trusted_device_fingerprints, 25 if failed_attempts_24h is at least 5, 20 if kyc_status is not VERIFIED, 15 if kyc_expiry is before attempt_time, and 10 if password_reset_recent is true. Cap at 100.
- access_decision is DENY at 70 or above, CHALLENGE from 35 through 69, and ALLOW below 35. primary_reason precedence is KYC_EXPIRED, KYC_NOT_VERIFIED, UNTRUSTED_DEVICE, COUNTRY_MISMATCH, FAILED_ATTEMPTS, PASSWORD_RESET, then LOW_RISK. profile_status is EXPIRED, UNVERIFIED, VERIFIED, or UNKNOWN using that same KYC-state precedence.

Create CTL2 for an ExtHashJoin component. Port 0 is the master MedicalClaim input and port 1 is the slave ProviderContract input. The graph is a left outer join on MedicalClaim.provider_id = ProviderContract.provider_id and MedicalClaim.service_code = ProviderContract.service_code. There is at most one contract row for the configured join key.

Port 0 metadata:
<Metadata id="MedicalClaimIn"><Record name="MedicalClaim" type="delimited"><Field name="claim_id" type="string"/><Field name="provider_id" type="string"/><Field name="service_code" type="string"/><Field name="service_date" type="date"/><Field name="billed_amount" type="decimal"/><Field name="member_copay" type="decimal"/><Field name="emergency_flag" type="boolean"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 1 metadata:
<Metadata id="ProviderContractIn"><Record name="ProviderContract" type="delimited"><Field name="provider_id" type="string"/><Field name="service_code" type="string"/><Field name="contract_start" type="date"/><Field name="contract_end" type="date"/><Field name="contracted_rate" type="decimal"/><Field name="authorization_required" type="boolean"/><Field name="provider_status" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>
Output metadata:
<Metadata id="ContractedClaimOut"><Record name="ContractedClaim" type="delimited"><Field name="claim_id" type="string"/><Field name="adjudication_status" type="string"/><Field name="allowed_amount" type="decimal"/><Field name="patient_responsibility" type="decimal"/><Field name="plan_liability" type="decimal"/><Field name="exception_reason" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>

Business logic:
- Missing contract means MANUAL_REVIEW, zero monetary outputs, and CONTRACT_NOT_FOUND.
- A matched contract is invalid when service_date is before contract_start, after a non-null contract_end, or provider_status is not ACTIVE. Invalid contracts produce DENIED, zero monetary outputs, and reasons OUTSIDE_CONTRACT_DATES or INACTIVE_PROVIDER in that precedence.
- Otherwise allowed_amount is the lower of billed_amount and contracted_rate. patient_responsibility is the lower of member_copay and allowed_amount. plan_liability is allowed_amount minus patient_responsibility. Round all monetary outputs to two decimals.
- adjudication_status is REVIEW_AUTHORIZATION when authorization_required is true and emergency_flag is false; otherwise APPROVED. exception_reason is AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED only for the review outcome and null for approved claims.

Write CTL2 for a Join component. Port 0 is the master UsageEvent input and port 1 is the slave Subscription input. The graph uses an inner join on UsageEvent.account_id = Subscription.account_id. Subscription has at most one matching row.

Port 0 metadata:
<Metadata id="UsageEventIn"><Record name="UsageEvent" type="delimited"><Field name="event_id" type="string"/><Field name="account_id" type="string"/><Field name="event_time" type="date"/><Field name="feature_code" type="string"/><Field name="units_consumed" type="long"/><Field name="source_region" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 1 metadata:
<Metadata id="SubscriptionIn"><Record name="Subscription" type="delimited"><Field name="account_id" type="string"/><Field name="plan_name" type="string"/><Field name="subscription_start" type="date"/><Field name="subscription_end" type="date"/><Field name="status" type="string"/><Field name="included_units" type="long"/><Field name="enabled_features" type="string" containerType="list"/><Field name="permitted_regions" type="string" containerType="list"/></Record></Metadata>
Output metadata:
<Metadata id="EntitlementDecisionOut"><Record name="EntitlementDecision" type="delimited"><Field name="event_id" type="string"/><Field name="account_id" type="string"/><Field name="decision" type="string"/><Field name="reason" type="string"/><Field name="billable_units" type="long"/><Field name="plan_name" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>

Business logic:
- Because this is an inner join, produce output only for matched account rows.
- Decision is DENY when event_time is before subscription_start, after subscription_end, or status is not ACTIVE. Reason precedence is BEFORE_SUBSCRIPTION, AFTER_SUBSCRIPTION, SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE. Billable units are zero for all denied events.
- For active in-term subscriptions, deny with FEATURE_NOT_ENTITLED when feature_code is absent from enabled_features, then REGION_NOT_PERMITTED when source_region is absent from permitted_regions. These denied events also have zero billable units.
- All other events are ALLOW. billable_units is units_consumed minus included_units when positive, otherwise zero. plan_name always comes from the slave Subscription row.

Create a transformation for an ExtHashJoin. Port 0 is the master ReturnRequest input and port 1 is the slave OrderLine input. The graph uses a left outer join on ReturnRequest.order_line_id = OrderLine.order_line_id; OrderLine is unique on that key.

Port 0 metadata:
<Metadata id="ReturnRequestIn"><Record name="ReturnRequest" type="delimited"><Field name="return_id" type="string"/><Field name="order_line_id" type="string"/><Field name="request_date" type="date"/><Field name="requested_qty" type="integer"/><Field name="return_reason" type="string"/><Field name="item_condition" type="string"/><Field name="refund_requested" type="decimal"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 1 metadata:
<Metadata id="OrderLineIn"><Record name="OrderLine" type="delimited"><Field name="order_line_id" type="string"/><Field name="order_date" type="date"/><Field name="shipped_date" type="date"/><Field name="delivered_date" type="date"/><Field name="item_price" type="decimal"/><Field name="purchased_qty" type="integer"/><Field name="return_window_days" type="integer"/><Field name="final_sale" type="boolean"/></Record></Metadata>
Output metadata:
<Metadata id="ReturnDecisionOut"><Record name="ReturnDecision" type="delimited"><Field name="return_id" type="string"/><Field name="decision" type="string"/><Field name="approved_qty" type="integer"/><Field name="approved_refund" type="decimal"/><Field name="disposition" type="string"/><Field name="reason" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>

Business logic:
- A missing order line is REJECTED with zero approved quantities and refund, disposition NONE, and reason ORDER_LINE_NOT_FOUND.
- For a matched row, reject FINAL_SALE when final_sale is true; reject OUTSIDE_RETURN_WINDOW when request_date is later than delivered_date plus return_window_days; reject INVALID_QUANTITY when requested_qty is zero, negative, or greater than purchased_qty. Apply this precedence.
- Otherwise approved_qty equals requested_qty. The maximum refund is item_price multiplied by approved_qty. approved_refund is the lower of refund_requested and that maximum, rounded to two decimals.
- disposition is RESTOCK for item_condition NEW or UNOPENED, REFURBISH for OPENED, and DISCARD otherwise. decision is APPROVED unless return_reason is FRAUD_SUSPECTED, in which case it is MANUAL_REVIEW with reason FRAUD_SUSPECTED and approved_refund zero. For an approved return, reason is null.

Create CTL2 for an ExtHashJoin with master port 0 and slave ports 1 and 2. The component performs left outer joins: Invoice.customer_id matches Customer.customer_id on port 1, and Invoice.customer_id plus Invoice.invoice_date matches the effective CustomerContract row on port 2. Port 1 has at most one row per customer. Port 2 has at most one row whose start_date is on or before invoice_date and whose null end_date or end_date on or after invoice_date makes it effective.

Port 0 metadata:
<Metadata id="InvoiceIn"><Record name="Invoice" type="delimited"><Field name="invoice_id" type="string"/><Field name="customer_id" type="string"/><Field name="invoice_date" type="date"/><Field name="gross_amount" type="decimal"/><Field name="currency" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 1 metadata:
<Metadata id="CustomerIn"><Record name="Customer" type="delimited"><Field name="customer_id" type="string"/><Field name="customer_name" type="string"/><Field name="credit_status" type="string"/><Field name="tax_exempt" type="boolean"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 2 metadata:
<Metadata id="CustomerContractIn"><Record name="CustomerContract" type="delimited"><Field name="customer_id" type="string"/><Field name="start_date" type="date"/><Field name="end_date" type="date"/><Field name="discount_pct" type="decimal"/><Field name="credit_limit" type="decimal"/></Record></Metadata>
Output metadata:
<Metadata id="InvoiceCollectionOut"><Record name="InvoiceCollection" type="delimited"><Field name="invoice_id" type="string"/><Field name="customer_name" type="string"/><Field name="net_amount" type="decimal"/><Field name="collection_status" type="string"/><Field name="hold_reason" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>

Business logic:
- A missing customer produces customer_name UNKNOWN, net_amount equal to gross_amount, collection_status HOLD, and hold_reason CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND.
- For a matched customer, apply the contract discount only when an effective contract exists; null discount_pct is zero. net_amount is gross_amount minus its discount, rounded to two decimals.
- collection_status is HOLD for credit_status BLOCKED, tax_exempt false with currency not EUR, or net_amount greater than the effective contract credit_limit. Use that precedence and reasons CREDIT_BLOCKED, TAX_CONFIGURATION, CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
- Otherwise collection_status is COLLECT and hold_reason is null. A missing contract never causes a hold and has no effect on credit-limit testing.

Write a transformation for an ExtHashJoin with port 0 as the master and ports 1 and 2 as left-outer slave inputs. Transaction.customer_id joins Customer.customer_id on port 1; Transaction.account_id joins Account.account_id on port 2. Each slave key is unique.

Port 0 metadata:
<Metadata id="TransactionIn"><Record name="Transaction" type="delimited"><Field name="transaction_id" type="string"/><Field name="customer_id" type="string"/><Field name="account_id" type="string"/><Field name="amount" type="decimal"/><Field name="transaction_time" type="date"/><Field name="destination_country" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 1 metadata:
<Metadata id="CustomerIn"><Record name="Customer" type="delimited"><Field name="customer_id" type="string"/><Field name="risk_rating" type="string"/><Field name="residence_country" type="string"/><Field name="pep_flag" type="boolean"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 2 metadata:
<Metadata id="AccountIn"><Record name="Account" type="delimited"><Field name="account_id" type="string"/><Field name="account_status" type="string"/><Field name="opening_date" type="date"/><Field name="daily_limit" type="decimal"/><Field name="used_today" type="decimal"/></Record></Metadata>
Output metadata:
<Metadata id="TransactionScreeningOut"><Record name="TransactionScreening" type="delimited"><Field name="transaction_id" type="string"/><Field name="decision" type="string"/><Field name="risk_score" type="integer"/><Field name="primary_reason" type="string"/><Field name="remaining_daily_limit" type="decimal"/></Record></Metadata>

Business logic:
- Missing customer or missing account causes DENY. Reason precedence is CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND then ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND; score is 100 and remaining_daily_limit is zero.
- For matched rows, remaining_daily_limit is daily_limit minus used_today, floored at zero. Score starts at zero and adds 40 for a PEP customer, 25 for HIGH risk_rating, 20 when destination_country differs from residence_country, 20 when amount exceeds remaining_daily_limit, and 15 when account_status is not ACTIVE. Cap at 100.
- Decision is DENY for inactive accounts or score at least 70, REVIEW from 35 through 69, ALLOW below 35. Reason precedence is ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, PEP, HIGH_RISK_CUSTOMER, COUNTRY_MISMATCH, then LOW_RISK.

Create CTL2 for an ExtHashJoin with master port 0 and slave ports 1 and 2. Encounter.patient_id joins Patient.patient_id on port 1, and Encounter.provider_id joins Provider.provider_id on port 2. Both slaves use left outer joins and are unique by their key.

Port 0 metadata:
<Metadata id="EncounterIn"><Record name="Encounter" type="delimited"><Field name="encounter_id" type="string"/><Field name="patient_id" type="string"/><Field name="provider_id" type="string"/><Field name="encounter_date" type="date"/><Field name="procedure_code" type="string"/><Field name="charge_amount" type="decimal"/><Field name="emergency" type="boolean"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 1 metadata:
<Metadata id="PatientIn"><Record name="Patient" type="delimited"><Field name="patient_id" type="string"/><Field name="coverage_status" type="string"/><Field name="coverage_start" type="date"/><Field name="coverage_end" type="date"/><Field name="copay" type="decimal"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 2 metadata:
<Metadata id="ProviderIn"><Record name="Provider" type="delimited"><Field name="provider_id" type="string"/><Field name="credential_status" type="string"/><Field name="specialty" type="string"/><Field name="network_status" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>
Output metadata:
<Metadata id="EncounterRoutingOut"><Record name="EncounterRouting" type="delimited"><Field name="encounter_id" type="string"/><Field name="route" type="string"/><Field name="allowed_charge" type="decimal"/><Field name="patient_copay" type="decimal"/><Field name="reason" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>

Business logic:
- Missing patient routes to MANUAL with zero amounts and PATIENT_NOT_FOUND. Missing provider routes to MANUAL with zero amounts and PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND. Use patient precedence.
- A matched patient without ACTIVE coverage, with encounter_date before coverage_start, or after non-null coverage_end routes to DENY with reasons COVERAGE_INACTIVE, BEFORE_COVERAGE, AFTER_COVERAGE in that order.
- An inactive provider credential routes to DENY with CREDENTIAL_INVALID. For every denial, amounts are zero.
- Otherwise allowed_charge is charge_amount for IN_NETWORK providers and 70% of charge_amount for all other network_status values, rounded to two decimals. patient_copay is the lower of Patient.copay and allowed_charge. Route is EMERGENCY_REVIEW when emergency is true and specialty is not EMERGENCY_MEDICINE; otherwise APPROVE. Reason is EMERGENCY_SPECIALTY_MISMATCH for review and null for approval.

Write a Join transformation with master port 0 and three left-outer slave ports. OrderLine.customer_tier plus OrderLine.sku joins Promotion on port 1; OrderLine.warehouse_id plus OrderLine.sku joins Stock on port 2; OrderLine.sku joins Product on port 3. Each configured slave key has at most one row.

Port 0 metadata:
<Metadata id="OrderLineIn"><Record name="OrderLine" type="delimited"><Field name="line_id" type="string"/><Field name="customer_tier" type="string"/><Field name="warehouse_id" type="string"/><Field name="sku" type="string"/><Field name="requested_qty" type="integer"/><Field name="unit_price" type="decimal"/><Field name="order_date" type="date"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 1 metadata:
<Metadata id="PromotionIn"><Record name="Promotion" type="delimited"><Field name="customer_tier" type="string"/><Field name="sku" type="string"/><Field name="start_date" type="date"/><Field name="end_date" type="date"/><Field name="discount_pct" type="decimal"/><Field name="max_qty" type="integer"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 2 metadata:
<Metadata id="StockIn"><Record name="Stock" type="delimited"><Field name="warehouse_id" type="string"/><Field name="sku" type="string"/><Field name="available_qty" type="integer"/><Field name="reserved_qty" type="integer"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 3 metadata:
<Metadata id="ProductIn"><Record name="Product" type="delimited"><Field name="sku" type="string"/><Field name="product_status" type="string"/><Field name="minimum_margin_pct" type="decimal"/></Record></Metadata>
Output metadata:
<Metadata id="OrderFulfillmentOut"><Record name="OrderFulfillment" type="delimited"><Field name="line_id" type="string"/><Field name="allocation_status" type="string"/><Field name="allocated_qty" type="integer"/><Field name="discounted_unit_price" type="decimal"/><Field name="line_total" type="decimal"/><Field name="exception_reason" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>

Business logic:
- Missing Product produces REJECTED, zero numeric values, and PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND. A product_status other than ACTIVE also produces REJECTED with PRODUCT_INACTIVE.
- Usable stock is available_qty minus reserved_qty, floored at zero; missing Stock is zero. allocated_qty is the lower of requested_qty and usable stock. allocation_status is ALLOCATED, PARTIAL, or BACKORDER accordingly.
- Apply a promotion only when its row exists, order_date falls in its inclusive date range, requested_qty does not exceed max_qty, and discount_pct is non-null. Otherwise discount is zero.
- discounted_unit_price is unit_price reduced by discount_pct percent, but never below unit_price multiplied by minimum_margin_pct divided by 100. Round discounted_unit_price and line_total, where line_total uses allocated_qty. exception_reason is OUT_OF_STOCK for BACKORDER, PARTIAL_STOCK for PARTIAL, and null for ALLOCATED.

Create CTL2 for an ExtHashJoin with master port 0 and slave ports 1, 2, and 3, all left outer. Timesheet.employee_id joins Employee on port 1; Timesheet.department_id joins DepartmentPolicy on port 2; Timesheet.tax_code joins TaxRate on port 3. Every slave key is unique.

Port 0 metadata:
<Metadata id="TimesheetIn"><Record name="Timesheet" type="delimited"><Field name="timesheet_id" type="string"/><Field name="employee_id" type="string"/><Field name="department_id" type="string"/><Field name="tax_code" type="string"/><Field name="work_date" type="date"/><Field name="regular_hours" type="decimal"/><Field name="overtime_hours" type="decimal"/><Field name="approved" type="boolean"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 1 metadata:
<Metadata id="EmployeeIn"><Record name="Employee" type="delimited"><Field name="employee_id" type="string"/><Field name="employment_status" type="string"/><Field name="hourly_rate" type="decimal"/><Field name="hire_date" type="date"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 2 metadata:
<Metadata id="DepartmentPolicyIn"><Record name="DepartmentPolicy" type="delimited"><Field name="department_id" type="string"/><Field name="overtime_multiplier" type="decimal"/><Field name="approval_required" type="boolean"/><Field name="maximum_daily_hours" type="decimal"/></Record></Metadata>
Port 3 metadata:
<Metadata id="TaxRateIn"><Record name="TaxRate" type="delimited"><Field name="tax_code" type="string"/><Field name="effective_from" type="date"/><Field name="effective_to" type="date"/><Field name="withholding_pct" type="decimal"/></Record></Metadata>
Output metadata:
<Metadata id="PayrollPreviewOut"><Record name="PayrollPreview" type="delimited"><Field name="timesheet_id" type="string"/><Field name="payroll_status" type="string"/><Field name="gross_pay" type="decimal"/><Field name="withholding" type="decimal"/><Field name="net_pay" type="decimal"/><Field name="exception_reason" type="string"/></Record></Metadata>

Business logic:
- Missing Employee or DepartmentPolicy produces HOLD with zero amounts; reasons are EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND then POLICY_NOT_FOUND.
- An employee whose employment_status is not ACTIVE is HOLD with INACTIVE_EMPLOYEE. When approval_required is true and approved is false, it is HOLD with APPROVAL_REQUIRED. When regular_hours plus overtime_hours exceeds maximum_daily_hours, it is HOLD with DAILY_HOURS_EXCEEDED. Use this precedence.
- A tax rate is usable only when its row exists and work_date is within its inclusive effective range; a null effective_to has no end date. An unusable rate produces HOLD with TAX_RATE_MISSING.
- Otherwise gross_pay is hourly_rate times regular_hours plus hourly_rate times overtime_multiplier times overtime_hours. withholding is gross_pay times withholding_pct divided by 100. Net pay is gross_pay minus withholding. Round each amount to two decimals and set payroll_status READY with a null exception_reason.
